Name: Commands For Twitch Chat Mod
Author: Miihau
Description:
[center][size=6][u][url=http://]﻿[/url]﻿[b]Commands For [/b][b][color=#b4a7d6]Twitch[/color] Chat Mod[/b][/u][/size]
[size=5]This Mod adds the functionality of commands for the Twitch Chat mod.[/size]
[size=3] (Big thank you to the Stardew Valley Discord for the help with my silly coding questions)
[/size]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/miihau][img]https://i.ibb.co/jbZNLr7/61e11d430afb112ea33c3aa5-Button-1-p-500-1.png[/img][/url][/center][url=https://ko-fi.com/miihau]
[/url]
[size=5][u]How it works[/u] [/size][size=2]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Install SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30798]Twitch Chat Mod[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod[/size]
[*][size=2]Add all mod to your SMAPI mods folder[/size]
[*][size=2]Configure both configs to your liking[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Current Command List[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Make farmer drink beer[/size]
[*][size=2]Gain specific or random amount of money[/size]
[*][size=2]Lose specific or random amount of money[/size]
[*][size=2]Play a specified sound (eg. Duck Sound)[/size]
[*][size=2]Play a random sound[/size]
[*][size=2]Open a random dialogue with a random NPC (dialogue is customizable in the assets)[/size]
[*][size=2]Place a bomb on top of farmer[/size]
[*][size=2]Warp to a specified location (eg. back to the farm)[/size]
[*][size=2]Warp to a random location [/size]
[*][size=2]Equip a random hat[/size]
[*][size=2]Shuffle the farmers inventory[/size]
[*][size=2]Delete a random item from the farmers inventory[/size]
[*][size=2]Reverse your Control for a couple seconds (Keyboard only)[/size]
[*][size=2]Add or remove a random amount of health[/size]
[*][size=2]Add or remove a random amount of energy [/size]
[*][size=2]Give the farmer -3 speed for a couple seconds[/size]
[*][size=2]Give the farmer +3 speed for a couple seconds[/size]
[*][size=2]Freeze the farmer in place for a couple seconds[/size]
[*][size=2]Make farmer do a random fishing minigame[/size]
[*][size=2]Spawn a random monster close-ish to the farmer[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Customization Options[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Setting a specific list of Twitch usernames that can active commands (useful if you want to work with redeems -> only allow your chat bot to activate commands. leave empty for everyone)[/size]
[*][size=2]Setting a minimum amount of time before any command can be activated again.[/size]
[*][size=2]Change each word that activates each command (eg. [i]!pam[/i] for drinking beer)[/size]
[*][size=2]Enable or disable any command[/size]
[*][size=2]Setting a daily limit on any command[/size]
[*][size=2]Setting a minimum time before a specific command can be activated again (HIGHLY recommended for busy chats)[/size]
[*][size=2]Setting a the amounts commands use (eg. the amount of money you gain/lose, or the amount seconds your controls get reversed)[/size]
[*][size=2]Setting a specific location warp and sound command[/size]
[*][size=2]You can add or edit extra random dialogue for the random dialogue in the assets file[/size]
[*][size=2](You can turn off chat showing up in the ingame chat AND what users from chat should be ignored in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30798]Twitch Chat Mod[/url] config, if wanted)[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Video showing off all current commands[/u]
[/size][youtube]oQi41BUuU2s[/youtube]
[size=5][u]Roadmap[/u] [/size][size=2](stuff I want to add)[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Add more effects [/size]
[*][size=2]Add i18n translation support[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][u]DISCLAIMER[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]This mod has [color=#ea9999][u]not[/u][/color] been tested a ton
[*]I tested the mod moderately alone and with friends spamming my twitch chat
[*]this mod has [color=#ea9999][u]not[/u][/color] been tested in multiplayer (neither online or local co-op)
[*]I don't recommend to allow the commands to be spammed, but it is possible to an extend from testing with my chatbot
[*]If you encounter any bug please report them in the bugs section of this mod page
[*]If you have an idea for a command that you would like to see adden feel free to leave a comment about it
[/list]
